intended_use.summary: Assess whether exact already-controlled Copernicus Sentinel-derived analytical outputs, USGS The National Map derivatives, and one exact MTBS-derived Ward Creek boundary may be assembled with repository-owned material into a local pre-publication portfolio candidate. No native provider archive, live service, deployment, or publication is in scope.
planned_actions: assemble an attributed repository-local pre-publication candidate from exact controlled derivatives
